about: Kryton support overlay (plan docs/plans/2026-11-26-cloudcli-podpora-a-stahovani-souboru-plan.md, P1, K1; operator Q-CCL-1 = A1). PERMANENT, no removal trigger: "Report issue" opens the help window of the Red Dwarf centre on the guide how-support-contacts-you (the address as the plugin Nastaveni pracovny computes it, from GET /user-auth/me), the upstream GitHub issues and Discord links are gone from the sidebar footer, the mobile menu, the collapsed rail and Settings > About. Applied by ../project-overlay/apply-project-overlay.mjs --overlay-dir, stage cloudcli-client, after the image overlay. `before` = the pin after the Czech, voice, brand, project, error and image overlays (AboutTab.tsx is the brand overlay's output: a re-cut of the brand overlay forces a re-cut here).

agpl.source: The overlay sources (files/, patches/) live in this repository and are applied to the /src tree of stage cloudcli-client (the image ships the built dist, not /src). Publishing that tree on the fork branch below is step K6 of the plan (HITL, step 7 of docs/runbooks/2026-09-12-cloudcli-subdomain.md); until then this directory is the source.
